test_healthcheck: test the API healthcheck endpoint by polling and asserting a 200 status code with ok in the response
run_test_healthcheck: run the healthcheck test that polls the API URL and verifies the response contains ok
review_test_healthcheck: review the test_healthcheck function that validates the API healthcheck endpoint returns a 200 status
summarize_test_healthcheck: summarize the test_healthcheck function which polls the healthcheck endpoint and asserts success
refactor_test_healthcheck: refactor the test_healthcheck function to support additional healthcheck response validation
